questionsToConsider: How much notice do you need for a van or a truck compared with a car?
Do you move hazardous or temperature-sensitive goods at all, or should the form rule them out?
Does every request need a cost code, or only some departments?
Who approves transport spending, and should the form ask for their name?
guide.howToUseResponses: Sort requests by departure time and check the load size and handling answers first, since they decide which vehicle or supplier you need. Call the requester when the load size is marked not sure or hazardous materials are involved. Grouping requests by route in an exported CSV shows trips that could share a vehicle, which is often the easiest saving.
customizeSteps: Edit the load sizes and handling options to match the vehicles and suppliers you use.
Make the cost code question required if finance needs it on every trip.
Share the link on your intranet or operations page, and ask teams to use it instead of emailing the coordinator.

faqs.q: What should a transportation request form include?
faqs.a: Who is asking, what or who is moving, the pickup and drop-off points, the date and time, and anything that affects the vehicle choice, such as group size, load size or accessibility.

faqs.q: Can one form handle both passengers and goods?
faqs.a: Yes. This one asks which it is first and then shows only the questions that apply, so a group booking never sees questions about pallets.

faqs.q: How far ahead should transport be requested?
faqs.a: It depends on your vehicles and suppliers. State your own lead time in the greeting so people plan accordingly.

faqs.q: Can I add an approval step?
faqs.a: You can add a question naming the approver, and read or export requests from the dashboard to pass on. Copy the form with Use this template to add it.
